name: Family Business
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach The Outfit: Family Owned and Operated, Reign and Reverie's Weyland identity, which gains 3[credit] whenever it takes bad publicity. Hostile Bid's frame of bad publicity, with two Broad Daylight for its two Azef Protocol, point for point, an agenda that takes a bad publicity and counts every one into meat damage. Eternal-legal only: Reign and Reverie is in neither Startup nor Standard. FFG F2 Stage 5. FFG F2 Stage 8: two Drudge Work for its two Wall to Wall, asset for asset. FFG F2 Stage 10: two Formicary for its two Shadow, ice for ice. Kitara Stage 2 took two Masvingo, an Oduduwa and two Forced Connection for its Valentãos, Colossus and Crisium Grids. Kitara Stage 5a: two Wake Up Call for a Building Blocks and an Under the Bus. Kitara Stage 12a: two Death and Taxes for two Security Subcontract, a current that pays the Corp for each Runner install and each installed card the Runner trashes; Hostile Bid keeps Security Subcontract. Red Sand Stage 1: two Battlement and two Watchtower for two Hadrian's Wall and two Hortum. Red Sand Stage 2: two Fractal Threat Matrix for two Forced Connection. Red Sand Stage 3: two Meteor Mining for two Sacrifice Zone Expansion, two Priority Construction for two Punitive Counterstrike, and a Mass Commercialization for the Too Big to Fail. Red Sand Stage 49: two Oberth Protocol for two Drudge Work, an upgrade that adds a counter to the first advance each turn in its server; Zugzwang and Yield Curve keep Drudge Work. Flashpoint Stage 4: Scarcity of Resources, Financial Collapse and Prisec for a second Battlement, Watchtower and Fractal Threat Matrix. Flashpoint Stage 5: Tribunal for a second Masvingo. Flashpoint Stage 6: Crisis Management for a Hostile Takeover, point for point; Door to Door for the Mass Commercialization; Liquidation, Stock Buy-Back and Sandburg for a Priority Construction, a Wake Up Call and the Research Station. Flashpoint Stage 7: Show of Force for a Broad Daylight, point for point; Best Defense, Enforced Curfew and Preemptive Action for a Shipment from Kaguya, a Death and Taxes and a Hostile Architecture. Flashpoint Stage 8: Illicit Sales for a Hostile Takeover, point for point; Mr. Stone, Hunter Seeker and Hailstorm for the Elizabeth Mills, the GRNDL Refinery and a Blockchain; Graft and a second Hailstorm for the Transport Monopoly and the Greenmail, point for point. Flashpoint Stage 9: Bloodletter for a Formicary. K. P. Lynn came in for Fractal Threat Matrix (Flashpoint Stage 14). FFG F5 Stage 15: one Chief Slee for one of its two Superdeep Borehole, a power counter for each subroutine a Runner lets through and five of them for five meat damage. Flashpoint Stage 18 put Bryan Stinson in for its Hostile Architecture. SanSan Stage 5: Wormhole, which resolves another rezzed ice's subroutine, for its Ice Wall, which other decks keep. Two Geothermal Fracking take an Above the Law's and an Off the Books's place, two points for two. Two Woodcutter take an Oduduwa's and an Enforced Curfew's place.
